name: iact_spica_magic_lst1
label: Spica on MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 at 425 nm: the binary fringe through four consecutive nights of the 4.01 d orbit (ln a, node, periastron free)
notes: Raiola et al. 2025 simulated the same system on these three baselines (Herbison-Evans 1971 orbit, a = 1.54 mas); hbtsim's Spica has a = 1.09 mas at phase 0 from the masses, period and 76.6 pc with e = 0.108.
Spica's fringe period lambda/rho is 80-200 m at 425 nm: the 45-107 m projected baselines sit on the first fringe; the 17 and 23 m pupils are averaged over.
